findings.issue: この is proximal ('this'), and the token gloss, lit_en, and expl_en all say 'this company'; the natural en uses the distal demonstrative 'That', contradicting the Japanese and the rest of the record.
何か 'something' is standardly read なにか (as taught in textbooks); なんか is a colloquial variant and mismatches the pedagogical dissection, which treats 何か as the indefinite pronoun 'algo'.
findings.current: なんかやくにたつことがしたい
findings.suggested: なにかやくにたつことがしたい

findings.issue: Token 何 in 何か ('something') should read なに, the standard reading of the indefinite pronoun; なん is the colloquial variant and misleads learners about the canonical reading.
Typo 'some' (3rd person of 'sumir', i.e. 'vanishes') where 'acrescenta/soma' ('adds') is meant — expl_en says も 'adds the sense'; as written the pt sentence says the opposite and is ungrammatical.
findings.current: 何回 ('quantas vezes') ganha も, que aqui some o sentido de quantidade indefinida e grande.
findings.suggested: 何回 ('quantas vezes') ganha も, que aqui acrescenta o sentido de quantidade indefinida e grande.

findings.issue: Duplicated word 'padrão padrão' ('the standard standard'); expl_en has 'the standard existence pattern of N5'.
findings.current: O par 「が…あります」é o padrão padrão de existência do N5.
findings.suggested: O par 「が…あります」é o padrão de existência do N5.

findings.issue: English gloss for この includes 'that', which この never means (that = その/あの); in context このゲーム = 'this game'. The 'esse' in the pt gloss is fine (BR anaphoric usage), but the en gloss should be 'this' only.
